content: Hi! How can I help you with your files today?
Hey! I just wrapped up the project meeting, can you help me share the recording and slide deck with the team?
Absolutely, thanks for reaching out. I've created a folder called 'Project Meeting - June' with the video recording and slides. Would you like the share link?
Yes, please send me the link so I can double-check everything before sending it out.
Here you go: <project_meeting_folder_link>. Feel free to click and browse, everything's labeled by date and topic. Let me know if anything's missing.
Just checked, the files are there! Should I download the originals before sharing them?
That's a great idea. Downloading ensures you have the highest quality versions. If you need just the slides or recording, each item is easy to select.
Perfect. Also, I noticed the recording doesn't have subtitles. Any tips on adding those?
Great catch! Adding captions helps everyone follow along. You can use your video editor to add subtitles, or try an auto-caption tool, just double-check for accuracy.
Got it. Should I include brief descriptions for the graphics in the slides too?
Yes, including alt text or short captions for visuals makes the deck more accessible. You can add these by right-clicking an image and selecting 'Edit Alt Text.'
Thanks for the reminder! Once I update those, should I re-upload the files?
That would be perfect. Just upload the revised versions into the same folder so everyone has the latest, most accessible files.
All set! Everything's uploaded and organized now.
Fantastic work! Please share the folder link with the team, and remind them to download any files they need. Let me know if you want help organizing future folders.
